scoring.A: Direct natural expression using the canonical 1,001 concepts plus ordinary grammar, morphology, and numeration.
scoring.B: Successful pre-frozen productive composition using only canonical concepts and already-authorized productive mechanisms, with explicit semantic equivalence required where safety-critical.
scoring.C: Genuine failure: neither direct expression nor a frozen admissible productive route completes the task.

evidence_sequence: Materialize and freeze the new 768-task battery plus every creditable productive route with no score.
Record exact battery freeze commit and blob.
Write task-level results without editing battery or productive rules.
Verify byte identity and stop before any failure-driven repair.
scientific_boundary: Internal prospective benchmark only; not third-party learner validation.
